title: HVAC and Plumbing in Converse, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Converse, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’re proud to serve Converse, TX, with expert HVAC and plumbing services. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing fast, reliable solutions for everything from air conditioning repairs to water heater installations. We focus on quality workmanship and customer satisfaction to make sure your home is always in top condition. Whether it’s an unexpected issue or routine maintenance, our team knows that having a dependable HVAC and plumbing system is a must. Trust us for all your heating, cooling, and plumbing needs.

Long stretches of summer heat mean air conditioners rarely get a break. When units start short-cycling, producing weak airflow or spiking energy bills higher than normal, our technicians step in. We also replace older systems that can’t keep up with demand, giving homeowners options that balance performance and budget. For ongoing care, our Comfort Club Membership provides a cooling tune-up before the hot season and a heating tune-up before cooler weather sets in. Members benefit from discounted repairs, priority scheduling and reduced service fees. For households running multiple HVAC systems, our Enhanced Maintenance Plan includes extra features like free drain line clearing and a lifetime thermostat warranty.

Major repairs or replacements can also be financed with approved credit through Service Finance Company, LLC, making it easier to move forward with needed upgrades. With an A+ BBB rating and over 10,000 customer reviews, we back our HVAC work with proven results recognized by both the industry and local homeowners.

Plumbing problems often show up as slow drains, low water pressure, or water heaters that can’t meet daily needs. Our plumbers handle everything from routine repairs to full system replacements. To prevent breakdowns, we offer a Plumbing Maintenance Program that includes an annual water heater flush, inspection of visible plumbing, pressure testing and more. These steps help catch hidden leaks, reduce sediment in the tank, and ensure pipes aren’t stressed by excessive pressure. Members also receive repair discounts throughout the year.

When larger jobs come up, we provide flexible financing options on approved credit for qualified customers. Our plumbing team operates with the same standards that earned us national recognition and community awards, including top ratings from Angi and Nextdoor. That track record reflects our commitment to keeping plumbing systems homes working day after day.
Our team offers an HVAC and plumbing service locals trust. Call Rosenberg Plumbing & Air in Converse today!
